recommendation: Use published teacher-operation aggregates to compare two explicitly idealized sampling schemes and quantify rare-group repetition before proposing any new training.
scope: Fix an illustrative draw count and compare uniform group sampling with equal-operation stratified sampling with replacement; report expected operation counts and expected unique rare groups, without opening raw data or running training or games.
limits: The historical trainer uses candidate-width-dependent packing and may select fewer than 256 groups per update; aggregate class frequencies cannot reconstruct its actual exposure.
